purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed NYC flight departure and arrival records for 2013 H1 sourced from bronze.nyc_flights, feeding downstream analytics on carrier on-time performance and route volume.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time as nullable and filter or explicitly handle nulls when a record represents a cancelled or diverted flight; join on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) to identify a unique flight occurrence, and treat time_hour as the scheduled hour bucket for time-series rollups.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the roughly 2.9%-3.3% null rates in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time, which likely represent cancelled or diverted flights and are retained as nulls rather than imputed; tailnum is also nullable (0.9% null, null_count=1521) and dest/tailnum values were not validated against an external airport or aircraft registry.
